name: lift-card
title: Lift cards
description: A photo tile and four tall centred link tiles that lift on hover, for an electric van dealer's ways to buy.
author: themes.dev

files.content:
import { ArrowRight, BriefcaseBusiness, CalendarCheck, Repeat2, Tag } from "lucide-react" import type { LucideIcon } from "lucide-react" export type ImageRef = { src: string; alt: string; width: number; height: number } export type Lift = { icon: LucideIcon; label: string; figure: string; unit: string; text: string; action: string; href: string } export type LiftCardProps = { kicker: string title: string body: string /** The photo tile that opens the strip. */ feature: { kicker: string; title: string; href: string; photo: ImageRef } items: Lift[] } export const liftCardDefaults: LiftCardProps = { kicker: "Ampway Vans, Leeds", title: "Four ways into an electric van", body: "Lease it, try it, buy it from stock or swap your diesel for it. Every route starts at our Kirkstall Road showroom or on your own yard.", feature: { kicker: "New for 2026", title: "Ampway Cargo L2, 264 km on a charge", href: "#cargo-l2", photo: { src: "https://www.themes.dev/ui/photos/lift-card/van.webp", alt: "A light grey electric delivery van parked on a brick-paved city street at dusk.", width: 720, height: 960, }, }, items: [ { icon: BriefcaseBusiness, label: "Business lease", figure: "£389", unit: "a month", text: "Ex VAT on a four-year lease, with servicing and tyres included.", action: "See lease deals", href: "#lease", }, { icon: CalendarCheck, label: "Test drive", figure: "48", unit: "hours", text: "Keep a loaded van over two days and run your real routes.", action: "Book a van", href: "#test-drive", }, { icon: Tag, label: "Stock offers", figure: "£2,500", unit: "off", text: "On 14 stock vans ready to drive away before 31 December.", action: "View stock", href: "#offers", }, { icon: Repeat2, label: "Trade in", figure: "1", unit: "day", text: "A firm price for your diesel van, held for 14 days.", action: "Value my van", href: "#trade-in", }, ], } export function LiftCard(props: Partial) { const c = { ...liftCardDefaults, ...props } return (

{c.kicker}

{c.title}

{c.body}

  • {c.feature.kicker} {c.feature.title}
    • {c.items.map((it) => { const Icon = it.icon return (
  • {it.label} {it.figure} {it.unit} {it.text} {it.action}
    • ) })}
) }
